verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents a first-party programmatic Node API: `runMC` can be embedded in CI scripts and servers, the reference covers embedding in custom applications, and the `mastracode/tui` export supports custom terminal interfaces. The evidence shows only a JavaScript/Node embedding surface, with no multi-language SDKs and no OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404). It also shows no install or versioning guidance for an SDK package, and no hands-on or independent corroboration. missing for 10: official SDKs in multiple languages, published API spec, dedicated SDK installation and versioning docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: `runMC` never calls `process.exit` and never writes to global streams, so it is safe to embed in CI scripts and servers.
Use it to embed Mastra Code in custom applications or extend its functionality.
Mastra Code exports the `MastraTUI` class from `mastracode/tui` for building custom terminal interfaces.
